text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Integration of renewables", "gist": "The main focus is integrating renewable energy sources"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The guiding theme of SWEET Call 1-2020 is “Integration of renewables into a sustainable and resilient Swiss energy system”", "gist": "SWEET Call 1-2020's main theme is integrating renewables into Switzerland's energy system"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "Renewables must be integrated into the Swiss energy system", "gist": "Renewables are required to be integrated into Switzerland's energy system"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "in order to ensure that demand is met; storage is available where and when needed; energy conversion is efficient, climate-neutral and net-negative", "gist": "Integration must ensure demand is met, storage is available when needed, and energy conversion is efficient, climate-neutral, and net-negative"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "must be integrated in such a way as to be of optimum value to the Swiss economy and society", "gist": "Integration must maximize value for Swiss economy and society"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "must also form part of the overall European energy system", "gist": "Integration must contribute to the broader European energy system"}]}
